def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def sha256_bytes(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def _policy_page_is_relevant_html(content: bytes) -> bool:
    text = content.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    # A successful response can still be only a generic Notion app/login shell.
    has_policy_id = bool(re.search(r"POL[- ]2026(?:\.2|[- ]2)", text, re.I))
    has_policy_body = bool(re.search(r"lodging|meal cap|permit approval|reimbursement", text, re.I))
    return has_policy_id and has_policy_body


def _validate_payload(source: NativeSource, content: bytes) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str | None]:
    """Return (usable, filename suffix, failure reason), without parsing case answers."""
    if source.kind == "notion":
        if not content or not _policy_page_is_relevant_html(content):
            return False, None, "HTTP response contained a generic Notion shell; policy page content was not accessible"
        return True, "html", None
    if source.kind == "pdf":
        if not content.startswith(b"%PDF-") or b"%%EOF" not in content[-2048:]:
            return False, None, "Export did not contain a complete PDF signature and trailer"
        return True, "pdf", None
    if source.kind == "xlsx":
        try:
            import io

            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(content)) as archive:
                if archive.testzip() is not None or "xl/workbook.xml" not in archive.namelist():
                    return False, None, "XLSX archive is corrupt or has no workbook index"
        except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
            return False, None, "Export was not a readable XLSX workbook"
        return True, "xlsx", None
    return (bool(content), "bin" if content else None, None if content else "Empty response body")


def _request(url: str, timeout: float) -> tuple[bytes, Mapping[str, str], str]:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "travel-claim-source-capture/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as response:
        return response.read(), dict(response.headers.items()), response.geturl()


def capture_sources(
    run_dir: Path,
    *,
    run_id: str,
    case_clock: str | None,
    source_specs: tuple[NativeSource, ...] = SOURCES,
    fetch: Callable[[str, float], tuple[bytes, Mapping[str, str], str]] = _request,
    observed_at: Callable[[], str] = _utc_now,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
) -> dict:
    """Freshly attempt every source and write exact returned bytes plus sources.json.

    `case_clock` is caller supplied scenario time. It may be null for a
    source-acquisition-only run where no supplied batch clock has been read.
    """
    if not run_id or Path(run_id).name != run_id or run_id in {".", ".."}:
        raise ValueError("run_id must be a single safe path component")
    if run_dir.name != run_id:
        raise ValueError("run_dir basename must equal run_id")
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    if manifest_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite source manifest: {manifest_path}")
    source_dir = run_dir / "sources"
    source_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if any(source_dir.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to reuse nonempty retained-source directory: {source_dir}")
    entries: list[dict] = []
    for source in source_specs:
        timestamp = observed_at()
        url_attempted = source.export_url or source.url
        try:
            body, headers, _final_url = fetch(url_attempted, timeout)
            usable, suffix, validation_error = _validate_payload(source, body)
            timestamp = observed_at()
            version = headers.get("ETag") or headers.get("Last-Modified")
            if usable:
                rel_path = Path("sources") / f"{source.source_id}.{suffix}"
                content_path = run_dir / rel_path
                with content_path.open("xb") as retained:
                    retained.write(body)
                entries.append({
                    "source_id": source.source_id,
                    "path": rel_path.as_posix(),
                    "sha256": sha256_bytes(body),
                    "status": "read",
                    "error": None,
                    "url": source.url,
                    "locator": source.locator,
                    "observed_at": timestamp,
                    "version": version,
                    "scope": source.title,
                    "missing_scope": [],
                })
            else:
                entries.append({
                    "source_id": source.source_id,
                    "path": None,
                    "sha256": None,
                    "status": "unavailable",
                    "error": validation_error,
                    "url": source.url,
                    "locator": source.locator,
                    "observed_at": timestamp,
                    "version": None,
                    "scope": source.title,
                    "missing_scope": [source.title],
                })
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            timestamp = observed_at()
            entries.append({
                "source_id": source.source_id,
                "path": None,
                "sha256": None,
                "status": "unavailable",
                "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                "url": source.url,
                "locator": source.locator,
                "observed_at": timestamp,
                "version": None,
                "scope": source.title,
                "missing_scope": [source.title],
            })
    manifest = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "source_version": "native-source-manifest/1",
        "case_clock": case_clock,
        "files": entries,
    }
    with manifest_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return manifest


def verify_source_manifest(run_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Check source manifest shape, five source attempts, and retained-byte hashes."""
    errors: list[str] = []
    path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Cannot read sources.json: {exc}"]
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        return ["sources.json must contain an object"]
    if set(manifest) != {"run_id", "source_version", "case_clock", "files"}:
        errors.append("sources.json must contain exactly run_id, source_version, case_clock, and files")
    if manifest.get("run_id") != run_dir.name:
        errors.append("sources.json run_id must match its run directory")
    if not isinstance(manifest.get("files"), list):
        return errors + ["sources.json files must be an array"]
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for record in manifest["files"]:
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            errors.append("every files[] entry must be an object")
            continue
        sid = record.get("source_id")
        if not isinstance(sid, str) or not sid or sid in seen:
            errors.append(f"source_id is empty or duplicated: {sid!r}")
        else:
            seen.add(sid)
        required = {
            "source_id", "path", "sha256", "status", "error", "url", "locator",
            "observed_at", "version", "scope", "missing_scope",
        }
        if not required.issubset(record):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: missing required metadata fields {sorted(required - set(record))}")
            continue
        if not isinstance(record.get("url"), str) or not record["url"] or not isinstance(record.get("locator"), str) or not record["locator"]:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: url and locator must be nonempty strings")
        if not isinstance(record.get("scope"), str) or not record["scope"]:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: scope must identify the observed source portion")
        if not isinstance(record.get("missing_scope"), list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in record["missing_scope"]):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: missing_scope must be an array of nonempty strings")
        try:
            observed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(record["observed_at"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            if observed.utcoffset() is None or observed.utcoffset().total_seconds() != 0:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: observed_at must be UTC")
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: observed_at must be an ISO UTC timestamp")
        if record["error"] is not None and not isinstance(record["error"], str):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: error must be a string or null")
        if record["status"] == "read":
            if not isinstance(record["path"], str) or not record["path"] or not isinstance(record["sha256"], str) or not record["sha256"]:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: read record has no retained path or hash")
                continue
            content_path = run_dir / record["path"]
            if not content_path.resolve().is_relative_to(run_dir.resolve()):
                errors.append(f"{sid}: retained path escapes the run directory")
                continue
            try:
                actual = sha256_bytes(content_path.read_bytes())
            except OSError as exc:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: cannot read retained content: {exc}")
            else:
                if actual != record["sha256"]:
                    errors.append(f"{sid}: retained content hash mismatch")
        elif record["status"] == "unavailable":
            if any(record[k] is not None for k in ("path", "sha256", "version")):
                errors.append(f"{sid}: unavailable scope must have null path, sha256, and version")
            if not record["error"]:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: unavailable scope has no error")
        else:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: invalid status {record['status']!r}")
    expected_urls = {source.url for source in SOURCES}
    observed_urls = {
        record.get("url")
        for record in manifest["files"]
        if isinstance(record, dict) and isinstance(record.get("url"), str)
    }
    if observed_urls != expected_urls:
        errors.append("manifest must cover exactly all five configured native source URLs")
    return errors
"""Schema-checked, content-addressed batch snapshots."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker

from .sources import sha256_bytes, verify_source_manifest


def _schema_errors(snapshot: dict, schema_path: Path) -> list[str]:
    schema = json.loads(schema_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
    return [
        f"{'.'.join(map(str, err.absolute_path)) or '<root>'}: {err.message}"
        for err in sorted(validator.iter_errors(snapshot), key=lambda e: list(map(str, e.absolute_path)))
    ]


def _check_semantics(snapshot: dict) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    issue_ids = [issue["record_id"] for issue in snapshot["issues"]]
    if len(issue_ids) != len(set(issue_ids)):
        errors.append("issues[].record_id values must be unique")
    issue_set = set(issue_ids)
    for cancellation in snapshot["travel_cancellations"]:
        missing = set(cancellation["issue_record_ids"]) - issue_set
        if missing:
            errors.append(f"cancellation {cancellation['cancellation_id']} refers to missing issue records: {sorted(missing)}")
    claim_ids = {claim["claim_id"] for claim in snapshot["claims"]}
    for request in snapshot["requests"]:
        if request["claim_id"] not in claim_ids:
            errors.append(f"request {request['request_id']} refers to missing claim {request['claim_id']}")
    cancellation_event_ids = {
        event_id
        for cancellation in snapshot["travel_cancellations"]
        for event_id in cancellation["admitted_cancellation_event_ids"]
    }
    overlap = cancellation_event_ids & set(snapshot["admitted_event_ids"])
    if overlap:
        errors.append(f"Finance admitted_event_ids must not contain cancellation activity IDs: {sorted(overlap)}")
    return errors


def verify_snapshot(snapshot_path: Path, run_dir: Path, schema_path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Verify this snapshot and every sealed snapshot in its predecessor chain."""
    return _verify_snapshot(snapshot_path, run_dir, schema_path, set())


def _verify_snapshot(
    snapshot_path: Path,
    run_dir: Path,
    schema_path: Path,
    seen_paths: set[Path],
) -> list[str]:
    """Validate schema plus source/predecessor hashes and required references."""
    resolved_snapshot = snapshot_path.resolve()
    if resolved_snapshot in seen_paths:
        return [f"predecessor cycle detected at {snapshot_path}"]
    seen_paths.add(resolved_snapshot)
    try:
        snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Cannot read snapshot: {exc}"]
    errors = _schema_errors(snapshot, schema_path)
    if errors:
        return errors
    errors.extend(_check_semantics(snapshot))
    errors.extend(verify_source_manifest(run_dir))
    try:
        manifest = json.loads((run_dir / "sources.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
            raise ValueError("sources.json must be an object")
        if manifest.get("run_id") != snapshot["run_id"]:
            errors.append("snapshot run_id does not match sources.json run_id")
        files = manifest.get("files", [])
        retained_ids = {
            record.get("source_id")
            for record in files if isinstance(record, dict)
            if record.get("status") == "read"
        }
        for claim in snapshot["claims"]:
            for line in claim["lines"]:
                missing_sources = set(line["source_ids"]) - retained_ids
                if missing_sources:
                    errors.append(
                        f"claim {claim['claim_id']} cost {line['cost_id']} refers to unavailable source IDs: {sorted(missing_sources)}"
                    )
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        manifest = {}
    source_binding = snapshot["source_binding"]
    source_path = run_dir / source_binding["path"]
    if not source_path.resolve().is_relative_to(run_dir.resolve()):
        errors.append("source_binding path escapes the run directory")
        return errors
    if source_path.resolve() != (run_dir / "sources.json").resolve():
        errors.append("source_binding must identify this run's sources.json")
        return errors
    try:
        actual = sha256_bytes(source_path.read_bytes())
    except OSError as exc:
        errors.append(f"Cannot read bound sources file {source_binding['path']}: {exc}")
    else:
        if actual != source_binding["sha256"]:
            errors.append("source_binding SHA-256 does not match retained sources.json")
    predecessor = snapshot["predecessor"]
    if predecessor is not None:
        previous_path = run_dir / predecessor["path"]
        if not previous_path.resolve().is_relative_to((run_dir / "batches").resolve()):
            errors.append("predecessor path escapes the run's batches directory")
            return errors
        try:
            actual = sha256_bytes(previous_path.read_bytes())
        except OSError as exc:
            errors.append(f"Cannot read predecessor {predecessor['path']}: {exc}")
        else:
            if actual != predecessor["sha256"]:
                errors.append("predecessor SHA-256 does not match retained snapshot")
            else:
                errors.extend(
                    f"predecessor chain: {error}"
                    for error in _verify_snapshot(previous_path, run_dir, schema_path, seen_paths)
                )
    return errors


def seal_batch_snapshot(
    run_dir: Path,
    *,
    run_id: str,
    batch_id: str,
    claims: list[dict],
    requests: list[dict],
    travel_cancellations: list[dict],
    admitted_event_ids: list[str],
    issues: list[dict],
    schema_path: Path,
    predecessor_path: Path | None = None,
    allow_unconfirmed_case_clock: bool = False,
) -> Path:
    """Seal one batch. Binding paths are relative to the run directory.

    Existing snapshots are never overwritten. The first snapshot uses a null
    predecessor; later snapshots hash the exact prior serialized bytes.
    """
    batches_dir = run_dir / "batches"
    batches_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not batch_id or Path(batch_id).name != batch_id or batch_id in {".", ".."}:
        raise ValueError("batch_id must be a single safe path component")
    target = batches_dir / f"{batch_id}.json"
    if target.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite sealed snapshot: {target}")
    source_path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    if not source_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required source manifest missing: {source_path}")
    source_errors = verify_source_manifest(run_dir)
    if source_errors:
        raise ValueError("Source manifest is not integrity-valid: " + "; ".join(source_errors))
    manifest = json.loads(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if manifest.get("run_id") != run_id:
        raise ValueError("Snapshot run_id must match sources.json run_id")
    if not manifest.get("case_clock") and not allow_unconfirmed_case_clock:
        raise ValueError("Cannot consume a batch without the supplied scenario case_clock")
    existing_snapshots = list(batches_dir.glob("*.json"))
    if existing_snapshots and predecessor_path is None:
        raise ValueError("A later batch must bind its predecessor snapshot")
    source_rel = Path("sources.json")
    predecessor = None
    if predecessor_path is not None:
        predecessor_path = predecessor_path.resolve()
        if not predecessor_path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Predecessor snapshot missing: {predecessor_path}")
        if predecessor_path.parent.resolve() != batches_dir.resolve():
            raise ValueError("Predecessor must be a retained snapshot in this run's batches directory")
        # Verify its source binding and full schema before chaining from it.
        predecessor_errors = verify_snapshot(predecessor_path, run_dir, schema_path)
        if predecessor_errors:
            raise ValueError("Predecessor snapshot is invalid: " + "; ".join(predecessor_errors))
        prior_state = json.loads(predecessor_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if prior_state["run_id"] != run_id:
            raise ValueError("Predecessor snapshot belongs to a different run")
        chain_paths: set[Path] = set()
        cursor = predecessor_path.resolve()
        while cursor not in chain_paths:
            chain_paths.add(cursor)
            cursor_state = json.loads(cursor.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            previous = cursor_state["predecessor"]
            if previous is None:
                break
            cursor = (run_dir / previous["path"]).resolve()
        existing_paths = {path.resolve() for path in existing_snapshots}
        if chain_paths != existing_paths:
            raise ValueError("Predecessor must be the end of the complete retained snapshot chain; orphaned or missing prior state found")
        predecessor = {
            "path": (Path("batches") / predecessor_path.name).as_posix(),
            "sha256": sha256_bytes(predecessor_path.read_bytes()),
        }
    snapshot = {
        "schema_version": "travel-claim-snapshot/2",
        "run_id": run_id,
        "batch_id": batch_id,
        "predecessor": predecessor,
        "source_binding": {
            "path": source_rel.as_posix(),
            "sha256": sha256_bytes(source_path.read_bytes()),
        },
        "claims": copy.deepcopy(claims),
        "requests": copy.deepcopy(requests),
        "travel_cancellations": copy.deepcopy(travel_cancellations),
        "admitted_event_ids": list(admitted_event_ids),
        "issues": copy.deepcopy(issues),
    }
    errors = _schema_errors(snapshot, schema_path) + _check_semantics(snapshot)
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("Refusing to seal invalid snapshot: " + "; ".join(errors))
    serialized = json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
    # Exclusive create prevents a concurrent run from replacing prior bytes.
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(serialized)
    errors = verify_snapshot(target, run_dir, schema_path)
    if errors:
        # Do not remove or rewrite a possibly observed sealed file. Surface the
        # integrity failure for operator investigation.
        raise ValueError("New snapshot failed post-seal integrity checks: " + "; ".join(errors))
    return target

"""Command-line interface for travel claim tooling."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker

from .outputs import write_claims_csv
from .offline_replay import run_offline_replay
from .parsing import parse_retained_run
from .snapshots import seal_batch_snapshot, verify_snapshot
from .sources import capture_sources, verify_source_manifest


def _default_schema_path() -> Path:
    """Return the repository's authoritative snapshot schema path."""
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "snapshot.schema.json"


def validate_snapshot(snapshot_path: Path, schema_path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Return validation errors for a snapshot and schema, or an empty list."""
    try:
        with snapshot_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as snapshot_file:
            snapshot = json.load(snapshot_file)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return [f"Snapshot file not found: {snapshot_path}"]
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Could not read snapshot {snapshot_path}: {exc}"]

    try:
        with schema_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as schema_file:
            schema = json.load(schema_file)
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Could not read schema {schema_path}: {exc}"]

    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
    errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(snapshot), key=lambda error: list(map(str, error.absolute_path)))
    return [
        f"{'.'.join(map(str, error.absolute_path)) or '<root>'}: {error.message}"
        for error in errors
    ]


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="travel-claim")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    validate = commands.add_parser(
        "validate-snapshot", help="validate a JSON snapshot against snapshot.schema.json"
    )
    validate.add_argument("snapshot", type=Path, help="path to the snapshot JSON file")
    validate.add_argument(
        "--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path(), help="schema JSON path"
    )

    capture = commands.add_parser("capture-sources", help="freshly retrieve and retain all five native sources")
    capture.add_argument("run_id", help="new, stable run identifier")
    capture.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path, help="new artifacts/runs/<run-id> directory")
    capture.add_argument("--case-clock", help="supplied scenario clock; omit only for source-only capture")

    verify_sources = commands.add_parser("verify-sources", help="verify source manifest and retained-byte hashes")
    verify_sources.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)

    parse_sources = commands.add_parser("parse-retained", help="transcribe hash-verified PDFs and workbook into traceable records")
    parse_sources.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)
    parse_sources.add_argument("--output", type=Path, help="optional new output path; defaults to parsed-records.json in the run")

    seal = commands.add_parser("seal-batch", help="schema-check and immutably seal one batch state JSON")
    seal.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)
    seal.add_argument("batch_id")
    seal.add_argument("state", type=Path, help="JSON object containing claims, requests, cancellations, events, issues")
    seal.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    seal.add_argument("--predecessor", type=Path)
    seal.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path())

    verify_batch = commands.add_parser("verify-batch", help="verify schema and source/predecessor bindings")
    verify_batch.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)
    verify_batch.add_argument("snapshot", type=Path)
    verify_batch.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path())

    csv_cmd = commands.add_parser("write-claims-csv", help="write the exact current-claim CSV contract")
    csv_cmd.add_argument("claims_json", type=Path, help="JSON array of current claim summary objects")
    csv_cmd.add_argument("output", type=Path)

    replay = commands.add_parser(
        "offline-replay",
        help="replay verified retained records in arrival order without fresh native-source reads",
    )
    replay.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path, help="existing retained-source run directory")
    replay.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path(), help="snapshot schema path")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "validate-snapshot":
        errors = validate_snapshot(args.snapshot, args.schema)
        if errors:
            print("Snapshot validation failed:", file=sys.stderr)
            for error in errors:
                print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Snapshot is valid: {args.snapshot}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "capture-sources":
        try:
            manifest = capture_sources(args.run_dir, run_id=args.run_id, case_clock=args.case_clock)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"Source capture failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        counts = {state: sum(row["status"] == state for row in manifest["files"]) for state in ("read", "unavailable")}
        print(f"Source capture complete: {args.run_id} ({counts['read']} read, {counts['unavailable']} unavailable)")
        return 0 if not counts["unavailable"] else 2
    if args.command == "verify-sources":
        errors = verify_source_manifest(args.run_dir)
        if errors:
            print("Source verification failed:", file=sys.stderr)
            for error in errors:
                print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Source manifest and retained bytes are valid: {args.run_dir}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "parse-retained":
        try:
            parsed = parse_retained_run(args.run_dir, output_path=args.output)
        except (OSError, ValueError, FileExistsError) as exc:
            print(f"Could not parse retained sources: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(
            f"Parsed {len(parsed['records']['claim_revisions'])} claim revisions, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['trips'])} trips, {len(parsed['records']['permits'])} permits, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['receipts'])} receipt records, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['decisions'])} decisions, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['finance_events'])} Finance events, and "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['cancellation_activities'])} cancellation activities; "
            f"arrival batches {parsed['arrival_batches']}; case clock {parsed['case_clock_state']}"
        )
        return 0 if not parsed["missing_sources"] and parsed["case_clock"] else 2
    if args.command == "seal-batch":
        try:
            state = json.loads(args.state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            snapshot_path = seal_batch_snapshot(
                args.run_dir,
                run_id=args.run_id,
                batch_id=args.batch_id,
                claims=state["claims"],
                requests=state["requests"],
                travel_cancellations=state["travel_cancellations"],
                admitted_event_ids=state["admitted_event_ids"],
                issues=state["issues"],
                schema_path=args.schema,
                predecessor_path=args.predecessor,
            )
        except (OSError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            print(f"Could not seal batch: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Sealed batch snapshot: {snapshot_path}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "verify-batch":
        errors = verify_snapshot(args.snapshot, args.run_dir, args.schema)
        if errors:
            print("Batch verification failed:", file=sys.stderr)
            for error in errors:
                print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Batch snapshot and bindings are valid: {args.snapshot}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "write-claims-csv":
        try:
            claims = json.loads(args.claims_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if not isinstance(claims, list):
                raise ValueError("claims JSON must be an array")
            write_claims_csv(claims, args.output)
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            print(f"Could not write claims CSV: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Wrote claims CSV: {args.output}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "offline-replay":
        try:
            result = run_offline_replay(args.run_dir, schema_path=args.schema)
        except (OSError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, FileExistsError) as exc:
            print(f"Offline replay failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"OFFLINE REPLAY complete: {result['run_id']} (no fresh native-source reads)")
        for snapshot in result["snapshots"]:
            print(f"Snapshot: {snapshot}")
        for label, output in result["outputs"].items():
            print(f"{label}: {output}")
        return 0
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
"""Fresh native-source retrieval and byte-bound source manifests.

This module deliberately has no cache/fallback path. Every capture invokes the
configured native URL or its documented export route again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Mapping


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NativeSource:
    source_id: str
    title: str
    url: str
    locator: str
    export_url: str | None = None
    kind: str = "binary"


SOURCES: tuple[NativeSource, ...] = (
    NativeSource(
        "policy-pol-2026-2",
        "Travel reimbursement policy POL-2026.2",
        "https://private-pecorino-70e.notion.site/REDACTED",
        "Notion policy page body",
        kind="notion",
    ),
    NativeSource(
        "initial-claim-binder",
        "Initial claim binder",
        "https://drive.google.com/file/d/13sRj6s_kMeP1hsYGstWWmfkb6SCN1YOS/view",
        "Complete PDF document",
        "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&REDACTED",
        "pdf",
    ),
    NativeSource(
        "claim-updates-binder",
        "Claim updates binder",
        "https://drive.google.com/file/d/REDACTED/view",
        "Complete PDF document",
        "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&REDACTED",
        "pdf",
    ),
    NativeSource(
        "receipt-binder",
        "Receipt binder",
        "https://drive.google.com/file/d/REDACTED/view",
        "Complete PDF document",
        "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&REDACTED",
        "pdf",
    ),
    NativeSource(
        "travel-registers-workbook",
        "Travel registers workbook",
        "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED/edit",
        "All workbook tabs via native XLSX export",
        "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED/export?format=xlsx",
        "xlsx",
    ),
)


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def sha256_bytes(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def _policy_page_is_relevant_html(content: bytes) -> bool:
    text = content.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    # A successful response can still be only a generic Notion app/login shell.
    has_policy_id = bool(re.search(r"POL[- ]2026(?:\.2|[- ]2)", text, re.I))
    has_policy_body = bool(re.search(r"lodging|meal cap|permit approval|reimbursement", text, re.I))
    return has_policy_id and has_policy_body


def _validate_payload(source: NativeSource, content: bytes) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str | None]:
    """Return (usable, filename suffix, failure reason), without parsing case answers."""
    if source.kind == "notion":
        if not content or not _policy_page_is_relevant_html(content):
            return False, None, "HTTP response contained a generic Notion shell; policy page content was not accessible"
        return True, "html", None
    if source.kind == "pdf":
        if not content.startswith(b"%PDF-") or b"%%EOF" not in content[-2048:]:
            return False, None, "Export did not contain a complete PDF signature and trailer"
        return True, "pdf", None
    if source.kind == "xlsx":
        try:
            import io

            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(content)) as archive:
                if archive.testzip() is not None or "xl/workbook.xml" not in archive.namelist():
                    return False, None, "XLSX archive is corrupt or has no workbook index"
        except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
            return False, None, "Export was not a readable XLSX workbook"
        return True, "xlsx", None
    return (bool(content), "bin" if content else None, None if content else "Empty response body")


def _request(url: str, timeout: float) -> tuple[bytes, Mapping[str, str], str]:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "travel-claim-source-capture/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as response:
        return response.read(), dict(response.headers.items()), response.geturl()


def capture_sources(
    run_dir: Path,
    *,
    run_id: str,
    case_clock: str | None,
    source_specs: tuple[NativeSource, ...] = SOURCES,
    fetch: Callable[[str, float], tuple[bytes, Mapping[str, str], str]] = _request,
    observed_at: Callable[[], str] = _utc_now,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
) -> dict:
    """Freshly attempt every source and write exact returned bytes plus sources.json.

    `case_clock` is caller supplied scenario time. It may be null for a
    source-acquisition-only run where no supplied batch clock has been read.
    """
    if not run_id or Path(run_id).name != run_id or run_id in {".", ".."}:
        raise ValueError("run_id must be a single safe path component")
    if run_dir.name != run_id:
        raise ValueError("run_dir basename must equal run_id")
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    if manifest_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite source manifest: {manifest_path}")
    source_dir = run_dir / "sources"
    source_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if any(source_dir.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to reuse nonempty retained-source directory: {source_dir}")
    entries: list[dict] = []
    for source in source_specs:
        timestamp = observed_at()
        url_attempted = source.export_url or source.url
        try:
            body, headers, _final_url = fetch(url_attempted, timeout)
            usable, suffix, validation_error = _validate_payload(source, body)
            timestamp = observed_at()
            version = headers.get("ETag") or headers.get("Last-Modified")
            if usable:
                rel_path = Path("sources") / f"{source.source_id}.{suffix}"
                content_path = run_dir / rel_path
                with content_path.open("xb") as retained:
                    retained.write(body)
                entries.append({
                    "source_id": source.source_id,
                    "path": rel_path.as_posix(),
                    "sha256": sha256_bytes(body),
                    "status": "read",
                    "error": None,
                    "url": source.url,
                    "locator": source.locator,
                    "observed_at": timestamp,
                    "version": version,
                    "scope": source.title,
                    "missing_scope": [],
                })
            else:
                entries.append({
                    "source_id": source.source_id,
                    "path": None,
                    "sha256": None,
                    "status": "unavailable",
                    "error": validation_error,
                    "url": source.url,
                    "locator": source.locator,
                    "observed_at": timestamp,
                    "version": None,
                    "scope": source.title,
                    "missing_scope": [source.title],
                })
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            timestamp = observed_at()
            entries.append({
                "source_id": source.source_id,
                "path": None,
                "sha256": None,
                "status": "unavailable",
                "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                "url": source.url,
                "locator": source.locator,
                "observed_at": timestamp,
                "version": None,
                "scope": source.title,
                "missing_scope": [source.title],
            })
    manifest = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "source_version": "native-source-manifest/1",
        "case_clock": case_clock,
        "files": entries,
    }
    with manifest_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return manifest


def verify_source_manifest(run_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Check source manifest shape, five source attempts, and retained-byte hashes."""
    errors: list[str] = []
    path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Cannot read sources.json: {exc}"]
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        return ["sources.json must contain an object"]
    if set(manifest) != {"run_id", "source_version", "case_clock", "files"}:
        errors.append("sources.json must contain exactly run_id, source_version, case_clock, and files")
    if manifest.get("run_id") != run_dir.name:
        errors.append("sources.json run_id must match its run directory")
    if not isinstance(manifest.get("files"), list):
        return errors + ["sources.json files must be an array"]
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for record in manifest["files"]:
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            errors.append("every files[] entry must be an object")
            continue
        sid = record.get("source_id")
        if not isinstance(sid, str) or not sid or sid in seen:
            errors.append(f"source_id is empty or duplicated: {sid!r}")
        else:
            seen.add(sid)
        required = {
            "source_id", "path", "sha256", "status", "error", "url", "locator",
            "observed_at", "version", "scope", "missing_scope",
        }
        if not required.issubset(record):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: missing required metadata fields {sorted(required - set(record))}")
            continue
        if not isinstance(record.get("url"), str) or not record["url"] or not isinstance(record.get("locator"), str) or not record["locator"]:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: url and locator must be nonempty strings")
        if not isinstance(record.get("scope"), str) or not record["scope"]:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: scope must identify the observed source portion")
        if not isinstance(record.get("missing_scope"), list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in record["missing_scope"]):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: missing_scope must be an array of nonempty strings")
        try:
            observed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(record["observed_at"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            if observed.utcoffset() is None or observed.utcoffset().total_seconds() != 0:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: observed_at must be UTC")
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: observed_at must be an ISO UTC timestamp")
        if record["error"] is not None and not isinstance(record["error"], str):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: error must be a string or null")
        if record["status"] == "read":
            if not isinstance(record["path"], str) or not record["path"] or not isinstance(record["sha256"], str) or not record["sha256"]:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: read record has no retained path or hash")
                continue
            content_path = run_dir / record["path"]
            if not content_path.resolve().is_relative_to(run_dir.resolve()):
                errors.append(f"{sid}: retained path escapes the run directory")
                continue
            try:
                actual = sha256_bytes(content_path.read_bytes())
            except OSError as exc:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: cannot read retained content: {exc}")
            else:
                if actual != record["sha256"]:
                    errors.append(f"{sid}: retained content hash mismatch")
        elif record["status"] == "unavailable":
            if any(record[k] is not None for k in ("path", "sha256", "version")):
                errors.append(f"{sid}: unavailable scope must have null path, sha256, and version")
            if not record["error"]:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: unavailable scope has no error")
        else:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: invalid status {record['status']!r}")
    expected_urls = {source.url for source in SOURCES}
    observed_urls = {
        record.get("url")
        for record in manifest["files"]
        if isinstance(record, dict) and isinstance(record.get("url"), str)
    }
    if observed_urls != expected_urls:
        errors.append("manifest must cover exactly all five configured native source URLs")
    return errors
"""Schema-checked, content-addressed batch snapshots."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker

from .sources import sha256_bytes, verify_source_manifest


def _schema_errors(snapshot: dict, schema_path: Path) -> list[str]:
    schema = json.loads(schema_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
    return [
        f"{'.'.join(map(str, err.absolute_path)) or '<root>'}: {err.message}"
        for err in sorted(validator.iter_errors(snapshot), key=lambda e: list(map(str, e.absolute_path)))
    ]


def _check_semantics(snapshot: dict) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    issue_ids = [issue["record_id"] for issue in snapshot["issues"]]
    if len(issue_ids) != len(set(issue_ids)):
        errors.append("issues[].record_id values must be unique")
    issue_set = set(issue_ids)
    for cancellation in snapshot["travel_cancellations"]:
        missing = set(cancellation["issue_record_ids"]) - issue_set
        if missing:
            errors.append(f"cancellation {cancellation['cancellation_id']} refers to missing issue records: {sorted(missing)}")
    claim_ids = {claim["claim_id"] for claim in snapshot["claims"]}
    for request in snapshot["requests"]:
        if request["claim_id"] not in claim_ids:
            errors.append(f"request {request['request_id']} refers to missing claim {request['claim_id']}")
    cancellation_event_ids = {
        event_id
        for cancellation in snapshot["travel_cancellations"]
        for event_id in cancellation["admitted_cancellation_event_ids"]
    }
    overlap = cancellation_event_ids & set(snapshot["admitted_event_ids"])
    if overlap:
        errors.append(f"Finance admitted_event_ids must not contain cancellation activity IDs: {sorted(overlap)}")
    return errors


def verify_snapshot(snapshot_path: Path, run_dir: Path, schema_path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Verify this snapshot and every sealed snapshot in its predecessor chain."""
    return _verify_snapshot(snapshot_path, run_dir, schema_path, set())


def _verify_snapshot(
    snapshot_path: Path,
    run_dir: Path,
    schema_path: Path,
    seen_paths: set[Path],
) -> list[str]:
    """Validate schema plus source/predecessor hashes and required references."""
    resolved_snapshot = snapshot_path.resolve()
    if resolved_snapshot in seen_paths:
        return [f"predecessor cycle detected at {snapshot_path}"]
    seen_paths.add(resolved_snapshot)
    try:
        snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Cannot read snapshot: {exc}"]
    errors = _schema_errors(snapshot, schema_path)
    if errors:
        return errors
    errors.extend(_check_semantics(snapshot))
    errors.extend(verify_source_manifest(run_dir))
    try:
        manifest = json.loads((run_dir / "sources.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
            raise ValueError("sources.json must be an object")
        if manifest.get("run_id") != snapshot["run_id"]:
            errors.append("snapshot run_id does not match sources.json run_id")
        files = manifest.get("files", [])
        retained_ids = {
            record.get("source_id")
            for record in files if isinstance(record, dict)
            if record.get("status") == "read"
        }
        for claim in snapshot["claims"]:
            for line in claim["lines"]:
                missing_sources = set(line["source_ids"]) - retained_ids
                if missing_sources:
                    errors.append(
                        f"claim {claim['claim_id']} cost {line['cost_id']} refers to unavailable source IDs: {sorted(missing_sources)}"
                    )
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        manifest = {}
    source_binding = snapshot["source_binding"]
    source_path = run_dir / source_binding["path"]
    if not source_path.resolve().is_relative_to(run_dir.resolve()):
        errors.append("source_binding path escapes the run directory")
        return errors
    if source_path.resolve() != (run_dir / "sources.json").resolve():
        errors.append("source_binding must identify this run's sources.json")
        return errors
    try:
        actual = sha256_bytes(source_path.read_bytes())
    except OSError as exc:
        errors.append(f"Cannot read bound sources file {source_binding['path']}: {exc}")
    else:
        if actual != source_binding["sha256"]:
            errors.append("source_binding SHA-256 does not match retained sources.json")
    predecessor = snapshot["predecessor"]
    if predecessor is not None:
        previous_path = run_dir / predecessor["path"]
        if not previous_path.resolve().is_relative_to((run_dir / "batches").resolve()):
            errors.append("predecessor path escapes the run's batches directory")
            return errors
        try:
            actual = sha256_bytes(previous_path.read_bytes())
        except OSError as exc:
            errors.append(f"Cannot read predecessor {predecessor['path']}: {exc}")
        else:
            if actual != predecessor["sha256"]:
                errors.append("predecessor SHA-256 does not match retained snapshot")
            else:
                errors.extend(
                    f"predecessor chain: {error}"
                    for error in _verify_snapshot(previous_path, run_dir, schema_path, seen_paths)
                )
    return errors


def seal_batch_snapshot(
    run_dir: Path,
    *,
    run_id: str,
    batch_id: str,
    claims: list[dict],
    requests: list[dict],
    travel_cancellations: list[dict],
    admitted_event_ids: list[str],
    issues: list[dict],
    schema_path: Path,
    predecessor_path: Path | None = None,
    allow_unconfirmed_case_clock: bool = False,
) -> Path:
    """Seal one batch. Binding paths are relative to the run directory.

    Existing snapshots are never overwritten. The first snapshot uses a null
    predecessor; later snapshots hash the exact prior serialized bytes.
    """
    batches_dir = run_dir / "batches"
    batches_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not batch_id or Path(batch_id).name != batch_id or batch_id in {".", ".."}:
        raise ValueError("batch_id must be a single safe path component")
    target = batches_dir / f"{batch_id}.json"
    if target.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite sealed snapshot: {target}")
    source_path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    if not source_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required source manifest missing: {source_path}")
    source_errors = verify_source_manifest(run_dir)
    if source_errors:
        raise ValueError("Source manifest is not integrity-valid: " + "; ".join(source_errors))
    manifest = json.loads(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if manifest.get("run_id") != run_id:
        raise ValueError("Snapshot run_id must match sources.json run_id")
    if not manifest.get("case_clock") and not allow_unconfirmed_case_clock:
        raise ValueError("Cannot consume a batch without the supplied scenario case_clock")
    existing_snapshots = list(batches_dir.glob("*.json"))
    if existing_snapshots and predecessor_path is None:
        raise ValueError("A later batch must bind its predecessor snapshot")
    source_rel = Path("sources.json")
    predecessor = None
    if predecessor_path is not None:
        predecessor_path = predecessor_path.resolve()
        if not predecessor_path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Predecessor snapshot missing: {predecessor_path}")
        if predecessor_path.parent.resolve() != batches_dir.resolve():
            raise ValueError("Predecessor must be a retained snapshot in this run's batches directory")
        # Verify its source binding and full schema before chaining from it.
        predecessor_errors = verify_snapshot(predecessor_path, run_dir, schema_path)
        if predecessor_errors:
            raise ValueError("Predecessor snapshot is invalid: " + "; ".join(predecessor_errors))
        prior_state = json.loads(predecessor_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if prior_state["run_id"] != run_id:
            raise ValueError("Predecessor snapshot belongs to a different run")
        chain_paths: set[Path] = set()
        cursor = predecessor_path.resolve()
        while cursor not in chain_paths:
            chain_paths.add(cursor)
            cursor_state = json.loads(cursor.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            previous = cursor_state["predecessor"]
            if previous is None:
                break
            cursor = (run_dir / previous["path"]).resolve()
        existing_paths = {path.resolve() for path in existing_snapshots}
        if chain_paths != existing_paths:
            raise ValueError("Predecessor must be the end of the complete retained snapshot chain; orphaned or missing prior state found")
        predecessor = {
            "path": (Path("batches") / predecessor_path.name).as_posix(),
            "sha256": sha256_bytes(predecessor_path.read_bytes()),
        }
    snapshot = {
        "schema_version": "travel-claim-snapshot/2",
        "run_id": run_id,
        "batch_id": batch_id,
        "predecessor": predecessor,
        "source_binding": {
            "path": source_rel.as_posix(),
            "sha256": sha256_bytes(source_path.read_bytes()),
        },
        "claims": copy.deepcopy(claims),
        "requests": copy.deepcopy(requests),
        "travel_cancellations": copy.deepcopy(travel_cancellations),
        "admitted_event_ids": list(admitted_event_ids),
        "issues": copy.deepcopy(issues),
    }
    errors = _schema_errors(snapshot, schema_path) + _check_semantics(snapshot)
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("Refusing to seal invalid snapshot: " + "; ".join(errors))
    serialized = json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
    # Exclusive create prevents a concurrent run from replacing prior bytes.
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(serialized)
    errors = verify_snapshot(target, run_dir, schema_path)
    if errors:
        # Do not remove or rewrite a possibly observed sealed file. Surface the
        # integrity failure for operator investigation.
        raise ValueError("New snapshot failed post-seal integrity checks: " + "; ".join(errors))
    return target

"""Command-line interface for travel claim tooling."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker

from .outputs import write_claims_csv
from .offline_replay import run_offline_replay
from .parsing import parse_retained_run
from .snapshots import seal_batch_snapshot, verify_snapshot
from .sources import capture_sources, verify_source_manifest


def _default_schema_path() -> Path:
    """Return the repository's authoritative snapshot schema path."""
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "snapshot.schema.json"


def validate_snapshot(snapshot_path: Path, schema_path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Return validation errors for a snapshot and schema, or an empty list."""
    try:
        with snapshot_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as snapshot_file:
            snapshot = json.load(snapshot_file)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return [f"Snapshot file not found: {snapshot_path}"]
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Could not read snapshot {snapshot_path}: {exc}"]

    try:
        with schema_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as schema_file:
            schema = json.load(schema_file)
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Could not read schema {schema_path}: {exc}"]

    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
    errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(snapshot), key=lambda error: list(map(str, error.absolute_path)))
    return [
        f"{'.'.join(map(str, error.absolute_path)) or '<root>'}: {error.message}"
        for error in errors
    ]


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="travel-claim")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    validate = commands.add_parser(
        "validate-snapshot", help="validate a JSON snapshot against snapshot.schema.json"
    )
    validate.add_argument("snapshot", type=Path, help="path to the snapshot JSON file")
    validate.add_argument(
        "--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path(), help="schema JSON path"
    )

    capture = commands.add_parser("capture-sources", help="freshly retrieve and retain all five native sources")
    capture.add_argument("run_id", help="new, stable run identifier")
    capture.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path, help="new artifacts/runs/<run-id> directory")
    capture.add_argument("--case-clock", help="supplied scenario clock; omit only for source-only capture")

    verify_sources = commands.add_parser("verify-sources", help="verify source manifest and retained-byte hashes")
    verify_sources.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)

    parse_sources = commands.add_parser("parse-retained", help="transcribe hash-verified PDFs and workbook into traceable records")
    parse_sources.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)
    parse_sources.add_argument("--output", type=Path, help="optional new output path; defaults to parsed-records.json in the run")

    seal = commands.add_parser("seal-batch", help="schema-check and immutably seal one batch state JSON")
    seal.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)
    seal.add_argument("batch_id")
    seal.add_argument("state", type=Path, help="JSON object containing claims, requests, cancellations, events, issues")
    seal.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    seal.add_argument("--predecessor", type=Path)
    seal.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path())

    verify_batch = commands.add_parser("verify-batch", help="verify schema and source/predecessor bindings")
    verify_batch.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path)
    verify_batch.add_argument("snapshot", type=Path)
    verify_batch.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path())

    csv_cmd = commands.add_parser("write-claims-csv", help="write the exact current-claim CSV contract")
    csv_cmd.add_argument("claims_json", type=Path, help="JSON array of current claim summary objects")
    csv_cmd.add_argument("output", type=Path)

    replay = commands.add_parser(
        "offline-replay",
        help="replay verified retained records in arrival order without fresh native-source reads",
    )
    replay.add_argument("run_dir", type=Path, help="existing retained-source run directory")
    replay.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=_default_schema_path(), help="snapshot schema path")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "validate-snapshot":
        errors = validate_snapshot(args.snapshot, args.schema)
        if errors:
            print("Snapshot validation failed:", file=sys.stderr)
            for error in errors:
                print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Snapshot is valid: {args.snapshot}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "capture-sources":
        try:
            manifest = capture_sources(args.run_dir, run_id=args.run_id, case_clock=args.case_clock)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"Source capture failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        counts = {state: sum(row["status"] == state for row in manifest["files"]) for state in ("read", "unavailable")}
        print(f"Source capture complete: {args.run_id} ({counts['read']} read, {counts['unavailable']} unavailable)")
        return 0 if not counts["unavailable"] else 2
    if args.command == "verify-sources":
        errors = verify_source_manifest(args.run_dir)
        if errors:
            print("Source verification failed:", file=sys.stderr)
            for error in errors:
                print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Source manifest and retained bytes are valid: {args.run_dir}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "parse-retained":
        try:
            parsed = parse_retained_run(args.run_dir, output_path=args.output)
        except (OSError, ValueError, FileExistsError) as exc:
            print(f"Could not parse retained sources: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(
            f"Parsed {len(parsed['records']['claim_revisions'])} claim revisions, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['trips'])} trips, {len(parsed['records']['permits'])} permits, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['receipts'])} receipt records, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['decisions'])} decisions, "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['finance_events'])} Finance events, and "
            f"{len(parsed['records']['cancellation_activities'])} cancellation activities; "
            f"arrival batches {parsed['arrival_batches']}; case clock {parsed['case_clock_state']}"
        )
        return 0 if not parsed["missing_sources"] and parsed["case_clock"] else 2
    if args.command == "seal-batch":
        try:
            state = json.loads(args.state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            snapshot_path = seal_batch_snapshot(
                args.run_dir,
                run_id=args.run_id,
                batch_id=args.batch_id,
                claims=state["claims"],
                requests=state["requests"],
                travel_cancellations=state["travel_cancellations"],
                admitted_event_ids=state["admitted_event_ids"],
                issues=state["issues"],
                schema_path=args.schema,
                predecessor_path=args.predecessor,
            )
        except (OSError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            print(f"Could not seal batch: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Sealed batch snapshot: {snapshot_path}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "verify-batch":
        errors = verify_snapshot(args.snapshot, args.run_dir, args.schema)
        if errors:
            print("Batch verification failed:", file=sys.stderr)
            for error in errors:
                print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Batch snapshot and bindings are valid: {args.snapshot}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "write-claims-csv":
        try:
            claims = json.loads(args.claims_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if not isinstance(claims, list):
                raise ValueError("claims JSON must be an array")
            write_claims_csv(claims, args.output)
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            print(f"Could not write claims CSV: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"Wrote claims CSV: {args.output}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "offline-replay":
        try:
            result = run_offline_replay(args.run_dir, schema_path=args.schema)
        except (OSError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, FileExistsError) as exc:
            print(f"Offline replay failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"OFFLINE REPLAY complete: {result['run_id']} (no fresh native-source reads)")
        for snapshot in result["snapshots"]:
            print(f"Snapshot: {snapshot}")
        for label, output in result["outputs"].items():
            print(f"{label}: {output}")
        return 0
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

configured native URL or its documented export route again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import urllib.error

def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def sha256_bytes(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def _policy_page_is_relevant_html(content: bytes) -> bool:
    text = content.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    # A successful response can still be only a generic Notion app/login shell.
    has_policy_id = bool(re.search(r"POL[- ]2026(?:\.2|[- ]2)", text, re.I))
    has_policy_body = bool(re.search(r"lodging|meal cap|permit approval|reimbursement", text, re.I))
    return has_policy_id and has_policy_body


def _validate_payload(source: NativeSource, content: bytes) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str | None]:
    """Return (usable, filename suffix, failure reason), without parsing case answers."""
    if source.kind == "notion":
        if not content or not _policy_page_is_relevant_html(content):
            return False, None, "HTTP response contained a generic Notion shell; policy page content was not accessible"
        return True, "html", None
    if source.kind == "pdf":
        if not content.startswith(b"%PDF-") or b"%%EOF" not in content[-2048:]:
            return False, None, "Export did not contain a complete PDF signature and trailer"
        return True, "pdf", None
    if source.kind == "xlsx":
        try:
            import io

            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(content)) as archive:
                if archive.testzip() is not None or "xl/workbook.xml" not in archive.namelist():
                    return False, None, "XLSX archive is corrupt or has no workbook index"
        except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
            return False, None, "Export was not a readable XLSX workbook"
        return True, "xlsx", None
    return (bool(content), "bin" if content else None, None if content else "Empty response body")


def _request(url: str, timeout: float) -> tuple[bytes, Mapping[str, str], str]:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "travel-claim-source-capture/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as response:
        return response.read(), dict(response.headers.items()), response.geturl()


def capture_sources(
    run_dir: Path,
    *,
    run_id: str,
    case_clock: str | None,
    source_specs: tuple[NativeSource, ...] = SOURCES,
    fetch: Callable[[str, float], tuple[bytes, Mapping[str, str], str]] = _request,
    observed_at: Callable[[], str] = _utc_now,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
) -> dict:
    """Freshly attempt every source and write exact returned bytes plus sources.json.

    `case_clock` is caller supplied scenario time. It may be null for a
    source-acquisition-only run where no supplied batch clock has been read.
    """
    if not run_id or Path(run_id).name != run_id or run_id in {".", ".."}:
        raise ValueError("run_id must be a single safe path component")
    if run_dir.name != run_id:
        raise ValueError("run_dir basename must equal run_id")
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    if manifest_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite source manifest: {manifest_path}")
    source_dir = run_dir / "sources"
    source_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if any(source_dir.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to reuse nonempty retained-source directory: {source_dir}")
    entries: list[dict] = []
    for source in source_specs:
        timestamp = observed_at()
        url_attempted = source.export_url or source.url
        try:
            body, headers, _final_url = fetch(url_attempted, timeout)
            usable, suffix, validation_error = _validate_payload(source, body)
            timestamp = observed_at()
            version = headers.get("ETag") or headers.get("Last-Modified")
            if usable:
                rel_path = Path("sources") / f"{source.source_id}.{suffix}"
                content_path = run_dir / rel_path
                with content_path.open("xb") as retained:
                    retained.write(body)
                entries.append({
                    "source_id": source.source_id,
                    "path": rel_path.as_posix(),
                    "sha256": sha256_bytes(body),
                    "status": "read",
                    "error": None,
                    "url": source.url,
                    "locator": source.locator,
                    "observed_at": timestamp,
                    "version": version,
                    "scope": source.title,
                    "missing_scope": [],
                })
            else:
                entries.append({
                    "source_id": source.source_id,
                    "path": None,
                    "sha256": None,
                    "status": "unavailable",
                    "error": validation_error,
                    "url": source.url,
                    "locator": source.locator,
                    "observed_at": timestamp,
                    "version": None,
                    "scope": source.title,
                    "missing_scope": [source.title],
                })
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            timestamp = observed_at()
            entries.append({
                "source_id": source.source_id,
                "path": None,
                "sha256": None,
                "status": "unavailable",
                "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                "url": source.url,
                "locator": source.locator,
                "observed_at": timestamp,
                "version": None,
                "scope": source.title,
                "missing_scope": [source.title],
            })
    manifest = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "source_version": "native-source-manifest/1",
        "case_clock": case_clock,
        "files": entries,
    }
    with manifest_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return manifest


def verify_source_manifest(run_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Check source manifest shape, five source attempts, and retained-byte hashes."""
    errors: list[str] = []
    path = run_dir / "sources.json"
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        return [f"Cannot read sources.json: {exc}"]
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        return ["sources.json must contain an object"]
    if set(manifest) != {"run_id", "source_version", "case_clock", "files"}:
        errors.append("sources.json must contain exactly run_id, source_version, case_clock, and files")
    if manifest.get("run_id") != run_dir.name:
        errors.append("sources.json run_id must match its run directory")
    if not isinstance(manifest.get("files"), list):
        return errors + ["sources.json files must be an array"]
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for record in manifest["files"]:
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            errors.append("every files[] entry must be an object")
            continue
        sid = record.get("source_id")
        if not isinstance(sid, str) or not sid or sid in seen:
            errors.append(f"source_id is empty or duplicated: {sid!r}")
        else:
            seen.add(sid)
        required = {
            "source_id", "path", "sha256", "status", "error", "url", "locator",
            "observed_at", "version", "scope", "missing_scope",
        }
        if not required.issubset(record):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: missing required metadata fields {sorted(required - set(record))}")
            continue
        if not isinstance(record.get("url"), str) or not record["url"] or not isinstance(record.get("locator"), str) or not record["locator"]:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: url and locator must be nonempty strings")
        if not isinstance(record.get("scope"), str) or not record["scope"]:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: scope must identify the observed source portion")
        if not isinstance(record.get("missing_scope"), list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in record["missing_scope"]):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: missing_scope must be an array of nonempty strings")
        try:
            observed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(record["observed_at"]).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            if observed.utcoffset() is None or observed.utcoffset().total_seconds() != 0:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: observed_at must be UTC")
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: observed_at must be an ISO UTC timestamp")
        if record["error"] is not None and not isinstance(record["error"], str):
            errors.append(f"{sid}: error must be a string or null")
        if record["status"] == "read":
            if not isinstance(record["path"], str) or not record["path"] or not isinstance(record["sha256"], str) or not record["sha256"]:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: read record has no retained path or hash")
                continue
            content_path = run_dir / record["path"]
            if not content_path.resolve().is_relative_to(run_dir.resolve()):
                errors.append(f"{sid}: retained path escapes the run directory")
                continue
            try:
                actual = sha256_bytes(content_path.read_bytes())
            except OSError as exc:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: cannot read retained content: {exc}")
            else:
                if actual != record["sha256"]:
                    errors.append(f"{sid}: retained content hash mismatch")
        elif record["status"] == "unavailable":
            if any(record[k] is not None for k in ("path", "sha256", "version")):
                errors.append(f"{sid}: unavailable scope must have null path, sha256, and version")
            if not record["error"]:
                errors.append(f"{sid}: unavailable scope has no error")
        else:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: invalid status {record['status']!r}")
    expected_urls = {source.url for source in SOURCES}
    observed_urls = {
        record.get("url")
        for record in manifest["files"]
        if isinstance(record, dict) and isinstance(record.get("url"), str)
    }
    if observed_urls != expected_urls:
        errors.append("manifest must cover exactly all five configured native source URLs")
    return errors
